ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited has publicly disclosed an unsolicited ESG score of 58.70, assigned independently by SES ESG Research Private Limited based on its FY2026 disclosures and public information. A key takeaway is the company's explicit statement that it did not engage the rating provider, highlighting a passively received, third-party assessment of its environmental, social, and governance performance. This moderate score contributes to the company's evolving public ESG profile, particularly as it's based on its inaugural Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report.
